caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a pair of metal tongs. The tongs are centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. They are rendered in shades of brown, giving the appearance of aged or rusted metal. The handles of the tongs are elongated and straight, converging at a rounded, closed loop at the top, which serves as the pivot or hinge. The gripping ends are shaped like stylized, open hands with distinct, finger-like projections and are oriented downward. There is a subtle shadowing around the edges of the tongs, enhancing the three-dimensional effect. In the lower right portion of the drawing, the artist's name, "PAUL TOFFINBARGER," is written in small, uppercase letters. There are no other objects or details present in the image.
title: Fireplace Tongs
